great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization' shall be utilized only after the Sum Insured has been completely exhausted;”
great.reference: Optional Cover 11: Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization (Clause 3.11)
great.explanation: An extra Sum Insured layer activates after your base Sum Insured is fully used, but only for accidental hospitalization if you opt for this cover. This gives you additional financial protection beyond the base limit in case of accidents.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: “First 30-Day waiting Period… Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents, which are covered immediately. This is a standard waiting period in health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “Specific Waiting Period… excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage”
good.explanation: Certain listed diseases or procedures are excluded for 24 months from policy start. This is the industry standard waiting time for specific illnesses.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: “Pre-existing Disease… shall be excluded until the expiry of 48 months of continuous coverage”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 48 months (4 years) from policy start. This is within the normal range and not a red flag.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: “Automatic Recharge… re-instatement of up to the Sum Insured once in a policy year… The Recharge shall be available only for all future Claims which are not in relation to any Illness or Injury for which a Claim has already been admitted”
good.explanation: The policy restores up to 100% of the Sum Insured once per year but only for unrelated illnesses. This helps cover new health issues after your limit is used.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “Relevant Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 30 days immediately prior”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 30 days before hospitalization are covered. This is a standard pre-hospitalization period.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “Relevant Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 60 days immediately after”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days after discharge are covered. This is an adequate post-hospitalization period at entry-level.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: “If the Policy Schedule states ‘Single Private Room’ as eligible Room Category… payable by the Company is limited to stay in a Single Private Room.”
bad.explanation: Coverage is limited to a Single Private Room; choosing a higher room category leads to proportionate deductions on claims. This restricts your room choice and can increase your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “Co-payment – 20% per claim, where age of insured / eldest member is 61 years or above”
bad.reference: Customer Information Sheet / KFD table (Clause 2(g) referenced)
bad.explanation: A mandatory 20% co-pay applies for insured persons aged 61 and above, increasing your share of claim costs. This raises out-of-pocket expenses for seniors.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: “Expenses incurred on treatment for Named Ailments / Procedures… up to the amount specified against each… in the Policy Schedule… (These conditions will apply only if specifically mentioned in the Policy Schedule)”
bad.explanation: Certain diseases or procedures have capped payouts if specified in the schedule, limiting claim amounts. This can cause significant out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – II to Policy Terms & Conditions).”
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables like gloves, masks, and syringes are excluded from coverage. This increases your out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization.

bad.name: NCB
bad.quote: “In the event of a Claim occurring during any Policy Year, the accrued No Claims Bonus will be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of next Policy Year”
bad.explanation: The No Claims Bonus decreases by 10% after a claim instead of being fully protected. This reduces your bonus benefits over time.

bad.name: Global Coverage Co-pay
bad.quote: “A mandatory Co-Payment of 10% per Claim is applicable, which will be in addition to any other co-payment (if any) applicable in the Policy.”
bad.explanation: Using global coverage (excluding USA) requires paying a mandatory 10% co-pay on each claim, increasing your costs. This reduces the effective coverage abroad.

bad.name: Co-pay Applicability
bad.quote: “If age of Insured Person or eldest Insured Person (in case of Floater) is 61 years or more, the Company provides an option… to choose for co-payment option of 20% per claim… and thereby get a discount of 20% in Premium” AND “Co-payment – 20% per claim, where age of insured / eldest member is 61 years or above”
bad.reference: General Conditions 2 / Clause 2(g)(I) AND KFD loss sharing table (Clause 2(g))
bad.explanation: One clause states the 20% co-pay for seniors 61+ is optional with a premium discount, while another suggests it applies by default. Check your policy schedule to confirm if senior co-pay is mandatory or optional.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
